_comment: Connections, directions, overview text, technical resources, things-to-know, and per-link data-mapping notes for all 15 ERP integrations. Sourced from each ERP's Procore product manual on v2.support.procore.com (overview / tutorials / permissions / diagrams / things-to-know / detailed-data-mapping / faq-or-troubleshooting). direction values: 'both' = bidirectional sync, 'to-erp' = Procore → ERP (export only), 'from-erp' = ERP → Procore (import only). Procore-to-module links are structural and have no direction or notes.

nodes.label: Viewpoint Spectrum
nodes.overview: Integration by Procore that connects Procore project financials with Trimble Viewpoint Spectrum accounting. Targeted at construction firms using Spectrum for AP, job cost, and prime contracts.
thingsToKnow: Limited to 1 Spectrum Company File per Procore site.
Commitment imports from Spectrum to Procore are not supported (export only).
Project names are capped at 25 characters.
Sub-jobs are disabled on Spectrum-connected projects.
Budgets must be locked before export and stay locked during sync.
After commitments sync, you cannot edit contract company, status, or SOV line items.
Unit of Measure (UOM) and Unit Qty values do NOT sync — must be entered manually in both systems.

nodes.label: Viewpoint Vista
nodes.overview: Integration by Procore that connects Procore with Trimble Viewpoint Vista, an enterprise construction ERP. Supports a wide range of bidirectional flows including budgets, prime contracts, direct costs, and payments.
thingsToKnow: Job Names have a 60-character limit — exports fail if exceeded.
In-progress projects cannot sync; professional services required to onboard them.
Once a budget is exported to Vista, the import direction for that job is disabled.
Unit of Measure (UOM) and Unit Qty values do NOT sync.
Commitment identifiers must be ≤30 characters and cannot include slashes.
Vista only allows modifying the same contract line item once per change order — Procore aggregates multiple changes into one.
Vendor address changes only sync if the 'Vendors will be automatically updated' setting is enabled.

nodes.label: QuickBooks Desktop
nodes.overview: Direct connector that links Procore with a QuickBooks Desktop company file via the QuickBooks Web Connector. Targeted at smaller construction firms running QuickBooks Desktop for AP, job costing, and budgets.
thingsToKnow: Limited to 1 QuickBooks Desktop Company File per Procore site.
Cannot sync data on projects created before ERP implementation went live.
Sync requires the QuickBooks Web Connector to be running on a logged-in Windows machine.
Prime contracts, timesheets, timecards, owner invoices, and payments do NOT sync.
Cost transactions must be coded to synced Service Items — items coded to unsynced accounts won't transfer.
Cost codes cannot exceed 96 characters.
Existing Procore projects cannot be linked to existing QBD jobs — records must originate in one system.

nodes.label: Sage 300 CRE
nodes.overview: Direct connector for Sage 300 CRE (Construction & Real Estate), a long-established construction accounting system. Supports payroll/timesheet export and a deep set of bidirectional financial flows.
thingsToKnow: New cost codes must be created in Sage 300 CRE, not in Procore.
Projects exported to Sage 300 CRE cannot be re-imported into Procore.
Tax information is not exported from Procore invoices — must be added manually in Sage.
Budget unlocking is restricted after export; requires manual posting and sync via the hh2 client.
Address changes only sync if the auto-update setting is enabled.
Sage 300 CRE limits modifying the same commitment line item once per CCO — Procore aggregates multiple changes.

nodes.label: Yardi Voyager
nodes.overview: Direct connector for Yardi Voyager, an ERP common in commercial real estate development. Supports vendor, job, budget, commitment, and payment sync with bidirectional invoices.
thingsToKnow: In-progress projects cannot sync; professional services required.
Yardi job IDs limited to 16 characters — caps Procore project naming.
All Yardi jobs must be under the same entity.
Commitment titles capped at 30 characters in Yardi (longer titles truncate).
Cost codes in a project template must already exist in the Yardi project before applying.
Purchase Orders require Implementation Specialist configuration before syncing.
Tax codes do NOT export with commitments.

nodes.label: NetSuite
nodes.overview: Direct connector for Oracle NetSuite, a popular cloud ERP. Used by construction firms running NetSuite for financials; the Procore integration focuses on vendors, jobs, cost codes, direct costs, invoices, and payments — budgets/commitments are not supported.
thingsToKnow: Single-tier cost codes are NOT supported — minimum 2-tier WBS required.
Limited to 1 NetSuite subsidiary per Procore site.
Prime contracts, budgets, commitments, change orders, and timecards do NOT sync.
Only accounting approvers can export cost codes, jobs, vendors, and sub invoices.
In-progress projects can't be onboarded without professional services.
Vendor edits flow NetSuite → Procore only — Procore changes don't update synced NetSuite vendors.
Job costs entered in NetSuite must use the integration-created project-specific items to come back to Procore.

nodes.label: Acumatica (Edge)
nodes.overview: Procore Edge connector for Acumatica Construction Edition. Provides one of the deepest integration scopes: bidirectional vendors, cost codes, jobs, budgets, direct costs, and payments; plus exported commitments, invoices, change orders, and prime contracts.
thingsToKnow: Commitments must originate in Procore — Acumatica-created commitments don't sync.
After exporting a budget, the import direction for that job becomes unavailable.
In-progress projects cannot sync without professional services.
Acumatica enforces a 30-character maximum on project names.
Sub Jobs require a default 'Empty Sub Job' task that cannot be deleted or edited.
All cost codes need at least one cost type assignment before exporting a project.
Budget sync is amount-based only — UOM and quantities do not transfer.

nodes.label: Acumatica (Vision)
nodes.overview: Procore Vision connector for Acumatica Cloud ERP. Vision is Procore's newer, deeper Acumatica integration (coming in 2025). Procore-to-Acumatica direction dominates: jobs, invoices, change orders, and prime contracts all export.
thingsToKnow: Procore Vision for Acumatica is rolling out — coming in 2025.
Project sync is export-only — projects must originate in Procore.
UOM and Unit Qty values do NOT sync — amount-based budgets only.
Commitments must originate in Procore — Acumatica-created commitments don't import.
Acumatica enforces a 30-character maximum on project names.
All project-level cost codes must come from the ERP-synced standard list.
Manual ERP Vendor ID entry required by an accounting approver when exporting companies.

nodes.label: MRI Platform X
nodes.overview: Integration by Procore for MRI Platform X (Project Financials). Used predominantly by real estate developers; bidirectional master data with one-way export for commitments and invoices, plus payment imports.
thingsToKnow: In-progress projects cannot sync.
Sub-jobs are NOT supported — each MRI job equals exactly one Procore project.
All integrated projects must share one unified cost code list originating from MRI.
All commitment SOV line items must tie to ERP-synced cost codes/categories.
Retainage release will NOT occur automatically — must be processed manually in MRI.
Verify duplicate company records don't exist before adding MRI vendors.
Tax codes do NOT export with commitments.

nodes.label: Sage Intacct
nodes.overview: Direct connector for Sage Intacct, a popular cloud-based financial management platform. Deep bidirectional sync of master data and budgets with one-way export of commitments, invoices, and change orders.
thingsToKnow: In-progress projects cannot sync without professional services.
UOM and Unit Qty values do NOT sync — amount-based budgets only.
Address changes in Sage Intacct don't auto-sync back to Procore after initial linking.
Companies must be created at top level in Sage Intacct — entity-level companies aren't detected.
After commitments sync, Procore restricts editing synced fields.
Prime Contract Change Orders won't create corresponding line items in Sage Intacct even when created in Procore.

nodes.label: Sage 100 Contractor
nodes.overview: Direct connector for Sage 100 Contractor (formerly Master Builder), a mid-market construction accounting platform. Bidirectional master data with one-way export for commitments, invoices, and change orders.
thingsToKnow: Commitments must originate in Procore — never create them directly in Sage 100 Contractor.
Purchase Orders must be quantity-based — Sage 100 doesn't support amount-based POs.
Once a budget is exported, you can no longer import budget/job data back from Sage 100 for that project.
Project-level cost codes must originate from the ERP-synced standard list — custom WBS unsupported.
Retainage handling differs between systems — released retainage cannot sync.
In-progress projects cannot sync without professional services.
Vendors need invoice defaults / ledger accounts configured in Sage 100 before subcontractor invoice export.

nodes.label: CMiC
nodes.overview: Integration by Procore for CMiC, a large-enterprise construction ERP. Deep integration covering bidirectional master data plus exported commitments and invoices and imported direct costs, payments, and prime contracts.
thingsToKnow: Most syncing is MANUAL — only Job Costs sync automatically.
After exporting a budget to CMiC, you cannot unlock, resend, add line items, or create modifications until posted in CMiC.
In-progress projects cannot sync without professional services.
Each CMiC company has its own cost code list, but Procore uses one shared list across all companies.
Vendor address changes don't sync — CMiC addresses are billing, Procore addresses are project mailing.
Multi-company setups require matching division/tier counts across cost code lists.
Every project cost code must have a cost type assignment before budget export.

nodes.label: QuickBooks Online
nodes.overview: Connects Procore with your QBO accounting system, uniting office and field teams with one source of project financial data. Targeted at construction companies that need synchronized financial information across departments.
thingsToKnow: Only QBO Plus or Advanced subscriptions are supported (Simple Start and Essentials are NOT supported).
Single-tier cost codes aren't supported — minimum 2-tier WBS required.
Projects must be created in QBO first; Procore-created projects cannot be exported.
Invoice numbers have a 21-character limit in QBO — Procore numbers must not exceed this.
Direct Costs synced from QBO are read-only in Procore; edit in QBO to update.
Vendor/Company edits don't sync after initial creation — changes in one system don't propagate to the other.
Multi-currency invoices only export if vendor/customer uses the QBO home currency.
Budgets, Commitments, Timesheets, Prime Contracts, and PCCOs do NOT sync.

nodes.label: Workday
nodes.overview: Integration by Procore for Workday, an enterprise HCM and financials platform. Bidirectional master data; commitments and invoices export as Supplier Contracts and Supplier Invoices respectively.
thingsToKnow: In-progress projects cannot sync without professional services.
Once a commitment syncs, contract company, status, and SOV become read-only.
Commitments without a Contract Date fail to export.
Vendor changes don't sync after initial creation in either system.
Cost codes must use at least a 2-tier hierarchical structure.
Unbudgeted line items won't transmit WBS codes to Workday unless added to the budget.
Tax code data does NOT export with commitments.

nodes.label: Xero
nodes.overview: Integration by Procore for Xero, a cloud accounting platform popular with smaller firms (esp. in AU/NZ/UK). Bidirectional vendors/jobs/cost codes; exported commitments, invoices, change orders; imported direct costs and payments.
thingsToKnow: Limited to 1 Xero Organization per Procore site.
Maximum 4,000 cost codes (Xero's product/service limit); codes capped at 30 characters.
Only new projects using the Xero Standard Cost Code list are eligible — in-progress projects can't transfer.
Sub-jobs are NOT supported for Xero-integrated projects.
Purchase and sales accounts must be assigned manually in Xero after cost codes are created.
Prime contracts, budgets, and timecards do NOT sync.
Xero blocks multiple modifications to the same contract line item — Procore aggregates them.

nodes.label: Foundation
nodes.overview: Foundation Software's construction accounting ERP. Available for Procore only via Agave Sync — Agave provides the entire integration layer: AP/AR Invoices and Payments, Vendors and Customers, Employees and Timecards, Budgets, Commitments, Job Costs, and Prime Contracts.
thingsToKnow: Procore → Foundation NOT supported for: Contract Payments, Direct Costs, Prime Contracts.
Budget Line Items, Prime Contract Change Orders, and Budget Modifications sync to Foundation only via Foundation's DataGenie workflow.
Attachments/file PDFs cannot sync — only URLs to files are supported.
Foundation enforces a 10-character ID limit on Purchase Orders and Subcontracts (shared table) — recommend custom ID format.
FSI Importer + Microsoft ODBC + Agave Connector must be installed and the Connector kept open/minimized.
Email addresses for Employees only sync on initial creation — updates are ignored to protect Procore login integrity.
Retention release is NOT yet supported for AR/AP Invoices.
Cost Codes can only originate in Foundation — they sync ERP → Procore, not the other way.

nodes.label: Deltek ComputerEase
nodes.overview: Deltek ComputerEase (formerly just ComputerEase) construction accounting ERP. Available for Procore only via Agave Sync. Scope is narrower than Foundation: master data, budgets, purchase orders, job costs, and timecards — no AP/AR invoice or payment sync.
thingsToKnow: No AP Invoice (Subcontractor Invoice) sync — invoices stay in Procore only.
No AR Invoice (Owner Invoice) or AP Payment sync.
No Prime Contract sync — only Prime Contract Change Orders (mapped to Job RFCs).
Cost Codes in ComputerEase are called 'Category Codes'; Sub Jobs are called 'Phases'.
Cost Types are link-only at company level — must be created in both systems manually before linking.
Payroll Job Cost descriptions are obscured to prevent salary data exposure in Procore.
Budget Line Items (Sub Job + Cost Code + Cost Type) must be unique per project — duplicates error.
Only POSTED ComputerEase Job Costs sync to Procore — unposted/draft items are skipped.

nodes.label: Acumatica
nodes.overview: Acumatica Construction Edition via Agave Sync. Procore-native has two Acumatica integrations (Edge + Vision); Agave provides a third route with the deepest scope of all three — every major financial object plus Employees and Timecards.
thingsToKnow: Procore → Acumatica NOT supported for: Departments, Contract Payments, Direct Costs, Equipment.
Attachments/file PDFs cannot sync — only URLs to files are supported.
Retainage release not supported for AR or AP Invoices (coming soon for AP with restrictions).
Custom fields on Procore Company records are NOT supported.
GL Accounts must be explicitly configured — required for all commitment and invoice line items.
Acumatica AP Invoices and AR Invoices export with default status 'On Hold'.
Default Project-Level Task (e.g. '0000') can be designated to avoid syncing as Sub Job.
Supports up to 3-tier cost code tiering when configured.

nodes.label: QuickBooks Desktop
nodes.overview: QuickBooks Desktop via Agave Sync. Wider scope than Procore-native QBD — Agave adds Employees, Timecards, AR Invoices, Customers, and bidirectional invoice flows that the Procore-native QBD connector doesn't support.
thingsToKnow: Procore → QB Desktop NOT supported for: Direct Costs, Sub Jobs.
Attachments/file PDFs cannot sync — only URLs to files are supported.
QB Desktop Chart of Accounts / G/L tracking must use Item-based tracking to work with Procore.
Billing Periods must be configured in Procore Projects before syncing AP/AR Invoices.
Custom fields on Procore Company records are NOT supported.
Verify QB Desktop version compatibility before implementation.
Customer field must be added as custom field in Procore for Project-to-QBD sync.
QB Desktop Classes map to Procore Cost Types — required by Procore even if unused in QBD.

nodes.label: Sage 100 Contractor
nodes.overview: Sage 100 Contractor via Agave Sync. Compared to the Procore-native Sage 100 connector, Agave adds Employees, Timecards, Customers, and bidirectional invoice + payment flows.
thingsToKnow: Procore → Sage 100 NOT supported for: Departments, WBS Segments, Sub Jobs, Direct Costs.
Attachments/file PDFs cannot sync — only URLs to files are supported.
Custom fields on Procore Company records are NOT supported.
Sub Jobs (Phases) is an optional feature requiring enablement by Account Manager.
One-to-one cost code line item mapping required in Sage 100 budgets and proposals.
Budget locking in Procore prevents original amount updates without explicit unlock.
Prime Contracts sync from Sage 100 Proposals (one line per cost code).
Voided costs in Sage 100 change status to Draft in Procore.

nodes.label: Sage Intacct
nodes.overview: Sage Intacct via Agave Sync. Requires Sage Intacct Construction Accounting module + Web Services Subscription ($2,500/year). Can integrate at top-level entity or child-entity level — child-entity recommended for flexibility.
thingsToKnow: Sage Intacct Construction Accounting module + Web Services Subscription required ($2,500/year for 100k requests).
Top-level entity integration may process significantly more data — child-entity recommended.
Custom fields on Procore Company records are NOT supported.
Vendors sync ERP → Procore only (not bidirectional).
Budget Line Items only sync Sage Intacct → Procore for 'Original' workflow type.
Budget view calculations may double-count when AP Invoices sync as Direct Costs — custom column config needed.
Document number required in Sage Intacct configuration for Subcontracts/POs.
Recommend Contract Date as required field in Procore — Sage Intacct mandates it.

nodes.label: Viewpoint Spectrum
nodes.overview: Trimble Viewpoint Spectrum via Agave Sync. Broadest connector scope across all Spectrum integrations — adds Employees, Timecards, Customers, Equipment, AR Invoices, AR Payments, and AP Payments beyond what Procore-native supports.
thingsToKnow: Procore → Spectrum NOT supported for: Departments, Contract Payments, Direct Costs, Employees.
Spectrum commitment numbers limited to 10 characters — Agave can auto-truncate longer Procore numbers.
Retainage release not supported for AR or AP Invoices — must release manually in Spectrum.
GL Accounts required in Spectrum — derived from Cost Type, Vendor default, or Agave-configured default.
Special characters in Vendor Codes cause sync failures.
Spectrum must use Master Job setup — child jobs sync as Sub Jobs in Procore.
Custom fields on Procore Vendors are NOT supported.
Multiple Info-Link tables required in Spectrum (varies by data type).

nodes.label: Viewpoint Vista
nodes.overview: Trimble Vista via Agave Sync. Most comprehensive Vista connector — adds Employees, Timecards, Customers, AR Payments and bidirectional financial flows that Procore-native handles differently or not at all.
thingsToKnow: Procore → Vista NOT supported for: Departments, Direct Costs.
Custom fields on Procore Companies are NOT supported.
Sub Jobs cannot reference multiple Sub Jobs within a single AP/AR transaction.
Budget Phase Locking in Vista may prevent cost posting — must unlock on Job record.
Only one Prime Contract per project allowed in Vista (Procore allows multiples).
Departments must be linked between Procore and Vista JC prior to Project export.
Billing periods required in Procore projects for invoice syncing.
Vista job numbering mask must follow predictable format (e.g. XXXXX-XX) for Sub Job parsing.
